findings.claim: Nvidia 集中採購 Vera Rubin 冷板，點名四家供應商：AVC、Cooler Master、Jentech、Delta；AVC 非唯一來源。
findings.source: DIGITIMES: Nvidia standardizes Vera Rubin liquid cooling, names four cold plate suppliers
findings.excerpt: Nvidia named Asia Vital Components (AVC) as one of four suppliers of cold plates for its Vera Rubin architecture, along with Cooler Master, Jentech, and Delta Electronics.

findings.claim: AVC 冷板市占約 30-40%，居 Cooler Master（50%+，GB200 機櫃）之後。
findings.source: 搜尋摘要（引 DIGITIMES／聚合報導）：AVC 冷板市占
findings.excerpt: Asia Vital Components holds approximately 30-40% market share for liquid cooling cold plates, placing it in second position behind Cooler Master's 50%+ share for GB200 racks.

findings.claim: Auras 預計 2026 Q3 出貨 Rubin 冷板模組，自估 Vera Rubin Group A 冷板供應占比 20-30%（同平台第二來源擴產）。
findings.source: 搜尋摘要：Auras Rubin 冷板占比（iteschina／聚合）
findings.excerpt: Auras expects to begin shipping Rubin cold-plate modules in Q3 2026. Auras estimates its supply share for Group A cold plates on the Vera Rubin platform at 20% to 30%, with the Group C area supply share exceeding 50%.

findings.claim: AVC 預計 Q3 開始出貨 Vera Rubin 冷板模組，並已進入 AWS、Google、Meta、OpenAI 的 AI ASIC 平台供應鏈。
findings.source: 搜尋摘要（DIGITIMES 系列報導）
findings.excerpt: AVC is expected to begin shipping Vera Rubin cold plate modules in the third quarter and has also entered the AI ASIC platform supply chains of AWS, Google, Meta, and OpenAI.

note: 查無 Nvidia 自製冷板的明確報導。摘要中另有「Hon Hai 自製冷板與分歧管」說法，但來源與日期不明，未列為 finding。2025 年報客戶集中度（最大客戶 22.74%、前三大 51.97%）來自 vocus 文章 https://vocus.cc/article/6a8d476ffd89780001160476，發布日未知，未列為 finding。
